description: Unit test class for UsernamePasswordCredentials in the org.eclipse.hono.service.auth.device package, verifying behavior in multi-tenant and single-tenant modes, especially parsing of username strings.

classes.name: UsernamePasswordCredentialsTest
classes.description: Test suite for UsernamePasswordCredentials class, focusing on tenant extraction logic based on username format and tenant mode.

methods.name: testTenantFromUserMultiTenant
methods.description: Tests that a username with 'user@tenant' format correctly parses tenant and username fields in multi-tenant mode.

methods.name: testTenantFromUserMultiTenantWrongUsername
methods.description: Tests that a username without tenant information results in a null credentials object in multi-tenant mode.

methods.name: testTenantFromUserMultiTenantWrongUsernameStructure
methods.description: Tests that a username with an incorrect separator ('/') instead of '@' results in null credentials object.

methods.name: testTenantFromUserSingleTenant
methods.description: Tests that in single-tenant mode, tenant is set to default value and username/password are correctly assigned.
